title: BlockSnack
description: A simple mod adding some decorative building blocks, starting with Terracotta Bricks.
body:
BlockSnack is simple mod that adds some decorative building blocks. The current version provides Terracotta Bricks in all 17 muted, but still glorious, colors. Now you can have some bricks for your buildings with a variety of colors. Note that terracotta bricks aren't as strong as clay-based bricks, so these blocks are slightly faster to mine but don't have quite as much blast resistance.

![Terracotta Bricks with a normal Bricks block for comparison](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/zZ6hLIpD/images/ebb358131ab2a53d68399655e64e924861098580.png)
# Instructions
First, you need **Terracotta Bricks**. These are made from **Terracotta** blocks using the **Stonecutter**.

> ![Cut your terracotta blocks into bricks using the Stonecutter.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/zZ6hLIpD/images/796e5e9bda9cf2ef96480b110b4fa4f4f9e91664.png)

Once you have **Terracotta Brick** items, combine them in the crafting grid just like normal Brick items. Voila! You now have **Terracotta Bricks** blocks.

> ![Combine your Terracotta Brick items into a block of Terracotta Bricks using the Crafting Table or the personal crafting grid.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/zZ6hLIpD/images/4d37882a88acd76cc609bdad46cb33059e5de9f0.png)

Just like vanilla Bricks, you can combine **Terracotta Bricks** into **Slabs**, **Stairs**, and **Walls**. The recipes are the same as standard Bricks and will appear in the Recipe Book too.

# Planned enhancements
These are in no particular order. If you have a preference, please check the issues list and give a thumbs up or add a comment. Suggestions for related blocks are welcome too!
- Concrete bricks for brighter colored brick blocks.
- An intermediate mortar item that will stretch your brick resources further.
